answer.explanation: Wallet is high, baseline 80% plus extra 30% due to low average contribution, so I contribute my full wallet. I also broadcast the norm reminder as required in the first round.

message.reasoning:

Compute avg: contributions sum =1+80+1+1+80+0=163 total pool? Actually total_pool 163 matches sum contributions. Avg per agent =163/6≈27.17 which is 27.17% of endowment (100). That's below 30% threshold, so we must increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet. Extra =0.3*140.75=42.225. So contribution =112.6+42.225=154.825 but cannot exceed wallet 140.75. So max is 140.75. So contribute all wallet? That is 100% of wallet. It's allowed. Constitution says increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet to push group back up. So we contribute full wallet 140.75.

Punish? Need check any agent contributed less than 10% for two consecutive rounds. Only round 1 data, no history. So no punish.

Communication: It's round 1, need broadcast norm message as first round. So broadcast: "Contributing 80%+ benefits everyone. Free‑riders will be punished."
